method.unit: ms per batch of identical sample inputs
method.api: render(source) followed by svg.length in Node; Rust returns an owned UTF-8 String.
method.utf8: Node render(source) followed by Buffer.from(svg, utf8); includes materialization, encoding and Buffer allocation. Rust String already owns contiguous UTF-8 bytes, so its measured time is shared by both comparisons.
method.excluded: process launch, imports, verification, disk I/O and warm-up; no parsing or result cache
